carriers.name: Estafeta
carriers.tracking_format: Official site describes a 22-digit guide number or a 10-digit tracking code.
carriers.proof_note: No general signature claim is made here; review the actual shipment record and service.

carriers.name: DHL Express (Mexico tracking page)
carriers.tracking_format: DHL Mexico says tracking IDs may contain numbers and letters; minimum 5 characters; format depends on business unit.
carriers.proof_note: No Mexico-wide signature claim is verified here; check the selected DHL service and shipment record.

carriers.name: FedEx (Mexico)
carriers.tracking_format: Enter the air waybill or tracking number supplied for the shipment; no single format is asserted.
carriers.proof_note: FedEx says a signed proof-of-delivery letter with signature image is available for FedEx Express when data is available; release agreements can mean no signature is available.

carriers.name: UPS (United States tracking)
carriers.tracking_format: UPS examples include 1Z followed by characters, 12 digits, T followed by digits, and 9 digits; other formats exist.
carriers.proof_note: UPS Signature Required shipments are signed for, but digital release can permit no-signature delivery in eligible cases; service and authorization matter.

carriers.name: USPS
carriers.tracking_format: Use the USPS tracking number on the mailpiece; this directory does not validate a number pattern.
carriers.proof_note: USPS says proof of delivery with signature is available only when Signature Confirmation or another listed eligible service is purchased or included; it is not a default for every item.

carriers.name: Correos de México / MEXPOST
carriers.tracking_format: For tracked mail, Correos describes two letters, nine digits, and two letters; formats depend on the selected postal service.
carriers.proof_note: MEXPOST lists an optional acknowledgment of receipt for national shipments; do not assume it is included in every postal service.

carriers.name: Paquetexpress
carriers.tracking_format: Official FAQ accepts a tracking code, guide number, or reference; no single character pattern is asserted.
carriers.proof_note: No general signature or signed proof-of-delivery rule is asserted; check the purchased service and its shipment record.

carriers.name: Redpack
carriers.tracking_format: The official page shows numeric guide examples and also offers tracking by client number plus reference; examples are not a universal format.
carriers.proof_note: No general signature or signed proof-of-delivery rule is asserted; review the selected Redpack service and actual record.

carriers.name: 99minutos
carriers.tracking_format: Company help examples include 99MEX plus digits or MX99 plus digits; the source says formats are general examples, not a validator.
carriers.proof_note: Company support says a delivery photo may be available for a shipment marked delivered; this is not a signature claim and depends on the recorded delivery.

carriers.name: iVoy
carriers.tracking_format: No universal guide-number pattern was verified; the carrier's business page describes tracking through its app/account.
carriers.proof_note: No universal signature or proof-of-delivery rule was verified; check the shipment's selected service and recorded events.
